records.rule: For the current string state, let i be the leftmost index with state[i] ≠ s2[i]. Try only j > i with state[j] = s2[i] and state[j] ≠ s2[j]. The last condition avoids borrowing a letter from an already correct position. Equal character counts guarantee that the unmatched part contains a misplaced copy of the needed letter. Keep every such j rather than choosing one greedily.
records.wrong: Counterexample: aabbcc → abcabc. Fixing the first mismatch using only the leftmost available letter gives aabbcc → ababcc → abcbac → abcabc, taking 3 swaps. Another choice gives aabbcc → abbacc (swap 1,3) → abcabc (swap 2,4), taking only 2. Repeated letters do not make the resulting suffixes equivalent. Four positions initially differ, so at least 2 swaps are necessary.
records.feedback: Check the letter condition again. The answer is {3}. At j=3, abcb has b while the target needs a there, so this b is misplaced. Swapping (0,3) immediately gives bbca in 1 swap. Index 1 also holds b but is already correct. Borrowing it gives bacb, requiring another swap (1,3). Matching the needed letter alone is insufficient; exclude already correct sources.

records.rule: 对当前字符串 state，令 i 为最左边 state[i] ≠ s2[i] 的下标。只尝试 j > i 且 state[j] = s2[i] 且 state[j] ≠ s2[j]。最后一个条件避免从已经正确的位置借字母。异位词保证：未匹配部分中一定有一个尚未放对的所需字母。仍须保留所有这样的 j，而非贪心选一个。
records.wrong: 反例：aabbcc → abcabc。若每次修好第一个错误位置，却只用最左边的可用字母，会走 aabbcc → ababcc → abcbac → abcabc，花 3 次。保留另一个选择则可走 aabbcc → abbacc（交换 1、3）→ abcabc（交换 2、4），只花 2 次。重复字母并不代表后续状态等价。初始有 4 处不同，所以至少需要 2 次。
records.feedback: 再检查字母条件。 答案是 {3}。abcb 的 j=3 是 b，目标该处要 a，所以它尚未放对。交换 (0,3) 直接得到 bbca，只需 1 次。j=1 虽然也是 b，却已经正确；若从那里借字母，会得到 bacb，还需交换 (1,3) 才到目标。保留所需字母还不够，必须排除已经放对的来源。

linkRecords.label: Sliding Puzzle: compare a state graph generated by swaps
linkRecords.destinationText: 03Search by layersHow can the first encounter with the goal prove the fewest moves? Breadth-first search (BFS) explores one move count at a time. The frontier contains every newly discovered state at distance d; seen is the set of all discovered states. The start is layer 0 because no move has been made.Keep 123405: 0 occupies position 4 (zero-based, row-major), so it can swap only with positions 1, 3, 5. This gives 103425, 123045, 123450, each reachable in 1 move. The last is the goal and layer 0 was not, so the answer is 1. Later, when 103425 generates 123405, seen rejects it: that board was already found at layer 0, and returning cannot improve its distance.This yields the invariant: on entering layer d, the frontier is exactly the states whose shortest distance is d, and seen is exactly those within distance d. One edge from the frontier reaches a state within d+1 moves. An unseen state cannot be within d moves, or it would already have been discovered. Its distance is therefore exactly d+1. Mark it seen immediately to avoid duplicates within the new layer. Every (d+1)-move path has a penultimate state within d moves, so the next layer misses no state either. This proof relies on every edge costing one move.Word Ladder II: retain shortest paths by layer →Finish “One move”, then select “Five moves”. linkRecords.label: 滑动谜题：比较交换生成的状态图
linkRecords.destinationText: 03逐层搜索这一步要回答：怎样知道第一次遇到目标就是最少步数？广度优先搜索（BFS）按步数一层层找。前沿是“刚发现、距离同为 d 步”的所有状态；seen 是已经发现的状态集合。起点在第 0 层，因为尚未移动。仍看 123405：0 在位置 4（从 0 开始按行编号），只能换位置 1、3、5，于是得到 103425、123045、123450。这三块棋盘都是 1 步可达。123450 已是目标，且第 0 层不是目标，所以答案是 1。下一次从 103425 生成 123405 时，seen 会拒绝它：它早在第 0 层就出现过，绕回去不会让路更短。由此得到不变量：进入第 d 层时，前沿恰好包含最短距离为 d 的状态，seen 恰好包含距离不超过 d 的状态。扩展前沿的一条边只会得到距离至多 d+1 的状态；未见过的状态不可能距离 ≤d，否则早已发现。因此新状态的距离恰为 d+1，发现时立即加入 seen，防止同层重复。任何 d+1 步的路径，其倒数第二个状态距离至多 d，所以新一层也不会漏掉状态。所有边都代表 1 次移动，此证明才成立。单词接龙 II：按层保留最短路径 →先用“一步到达”走到末尾，再选“五步到达”，逐层前进，查看保留的层记录。每帧显示进入该层时的全部前沿；候选账本展示上一层第一个状态的扩展，其余状态也已完整扩展。切换预设会重启此搜索。搜索预设（更换即重启）一步到达 · 123405五步到达 · 412503无法到达 · 123540已完成 · 123450换一个起点 · 012453教学模拟：JavaScript 按完整层生成快照，并非执行下面的 Python。Python 用队列逐个取出状态，可能在一层中途返回；最少步数相同。未截断任何层或前沿。一步到达 · 123405回到上一层生成下一层重置跳到搜索结论帧 0/1 · 进入第 0 层 · 前沿 1 个状态 · 累计发现 1 个状态。尚未给出最终答案。本层全部前沿棋盘空前沿：没有更多可达状态。每块棋盘始终为 2×3。极窄缩放时，可横滑棋盘，或聚焦棋盘后按左右方向键查看三列。123405123405累计层记录：已扩展层 → 本层状态数 → 新发现数尚未扩展起点。上一层首个状态的候选账本尚未扩展起点。
